services.value: Pacific Rim Laboratories provides low-level detection high resolution mass spectrometry trace analysis testing for dioxins, PCBs, PFAS, PBDE, PAH & alkylated PAH, OCP, TBT, NP and NPEO, and related samples (e.g., PFAS testing in water and soil down to low parts per trillion). They also offer the “Total Oxidizable Precursors Assay ('TOP Assay' or 'TOPA')” to estimate unconventional and polymeric PFAS precursors in water samples.
